title: Congress Day 1 - Natalie
description: R. John meets Natalie, calculating lobbyist, at the party congress.

nodes.text: Natalie approaches you during a coffee break. She's 33, sharp suit, sharper eyes. 'Senator. We should talk.'
Natalie: 'The healthcare bill. I represent several... interested parties.' She hands you a card. 'Natalie Cross, HealthFirst lobbying.'
Natalie: 'Good. I represent clients who want the healthcare bill amended. Generously.'

choices.text: Say he doesn't mix business and pleasure

nodes.text: Natalie: 'We met at the fundraiser. You were... memorable.' She smiles thinly.

choices.text: Say she made an impression too
Ask if this is business or pleasure

nodes.text: Natalie: 'Then you know I deliver results. For my clients. And for... associates.'
Natalie: 'Campaign contributions. Speaking fees. And other... benefits.' She holds your gaze.

choices.text: Say he wants details in private

nodes.text: Natalie: 'Six figures. Plus future arrangements.' She steps closer. 'But let's discuss terms privately.'
Natalie: 'Who said anything about pleasure?' She smirks. 'Though I'm not opposed to... multitasking.'
Natalie: 'I'm glad. Because I have a proposition. Mutually beneficial.'

choices.text: Ask if this is a bribe

nodes.text: Natalie: 'Why choose? I find the best deals combine both.' She checks her watch. 'I have 15 minutes before the next session.'
Natalie: 'Legislation passed. Careers advanced. Enemies... neutralized.' She smiles coldly.

choices.text: Say he could use those services

nodes.text: Natalie: 'My hotel room. 401. After the evening session.' She walks away before you can respond.
Natalie: 'Let's just say I'm very... hands-on with client relations.'
Natalie: 'Wise. The lobby bar. 8 PM. Don't wear your press badge.'

choices.text: Confirm and head back to session

nodes.text: Natalie: 'Good. Multitasking is undervalued in politics.' She hands you a key card. 'Penthouse suite. Midnight.'
Natalie: 'A partnership. You vote our way. We provide... incentives. Personal ones.'
Natalie: 'Vote against the amendment. In return, my clients fund your next campaign. And I provide... personal consultancy.'
Natalie: 'It's a business arrangement. Call it what you want.' She shrugs.

choices.text: Say he does business his way

nodes.text: Natalie: 'Agreed. The service elevator. Now.' She leads the way.
Natalie: 'Excellent. Let's discuss retainer terms. My office. Tomorrow.'
Natalie: 'For you? Flexible. Very flexible.' She smiles.
Natalie: 'I thought so. My room. After the session. We'll discuss... methodology.'
Natalie: 'Bold. I like that. My suite. 9 PM. Bring your questions.'
Natalie is already gone. The card says '401 - Knock twice.'
You head back to the session, thinking about 8 PM.
The key card is heavy, expensive. 'Midnight,' you repeat.
Natalie walks away without another word. The card has a suite number on the back.
Natalie: 'The kind that make politicians very... cooperative.' She winks.
Natalie: 'I knew you'd see reason. My lawyer will draft the agreement.'
Natalie: 'Very personal. Very thorough. Ask me tonight.'
Natalie: 'Then you'll like my way. Efficient. Discreet. Profitable.'
The service elevator is empty. Natalie presses the penthouse button.
Natalie texts you her office address. 'Bring your calendar.'
Natalie: 'Later. When we have more time. And privacy.'
Natalie: '305. Don't keep me waiting.'
You return to your seat, thinking about 9 PM.

endings.private_terms: Private terms discussion arranged. High risk, high reward.
